concept: Dark, sleek & modern. Minimal & premium. Moving away from earthy/soft to a cinematic, highly-restrained luxury aesthetic. A text-first AI companion that feels like an intimate late-night conversation, backed by a tactical, high-density admin panel.

tech_instructions.files: Use pure JavaScript (.jsx / .js), DO NOT output TypeScript (.tsx / .ts).

rules: No Inter, Roboto, or generic sans-serifs for headings.
Headings (H1/H2) MUST use Cormorant Garamond with tight tracking (`tracking-tight`) and `font-light` to `font-medium` weights to feel luxurious.
AI chat responses should use Cormorant Garamond at a slightly larger size (text-lg or text-xl) to give the AI a distinct, sophisticated 'voice', while user messages use Outfit.
Admin panel data, timestamps, and model routing info MUST use JetBrains Mono for a tactical, precise look.

surfaces.glass: bg-white/[0.03] backdrop-blur-2xl (For sidebars, floating headers, check-in banners)

accents.primary: #FFFFFF (Stark white for primary CTA buttons - pure monochrome contrast)
accents.safety_escalation: #E11D48 (Signal Red - CRITICAL requirement for risk classifier/escalation. Must contrast heavily against dark UI. Used for check-ins, human handoff, and crisis hotline links).

layouts.landing: Asymmetrical layout. Massive negative space. Hero image overlay max `bg-black/50`. Include 'Adults Only' and 'AI' disclaimers cleanly in typography, not hidden.
layouts.auth_and_onboarding: Centered, narrow column Stepper (4 steps). Fade-in animations for each step. Input fields should be 'flushed' (only bottom border, no full box) to maintain a minimal, luxury aesthetic.
layouts.chat_interface: DO NOT use generic iOS-style chat bubbles. The conversation is the hero. Left-aligned rolling log. AI messages occupy full width with serif typography and are explicitly labeled 'CampionAI'. User messages are indented right with a subtle left border. No background colors on messages, just pure text over the deep void background.
layouts.memory_drawer: A sleek side panel (`w-80`) with glassmorphism. Private Mode toggle should be a stark, crisp switch.
layouts.admin_panel: High Density Grid. 1px grid borders visible (`border-zinc-800`). No rounded corners on internal cards (sharp edges, tactical feel). Used for model routing, professionals CRUD, and safety events.

components.buttons: Pill-shaped (`rounded-full`) for consumer app (chat, onboarding), sharp (`rounded-none`) for Admin panel. Primary buttons: `bg-white text-black hover:bg-zinc-200`. Escalation buttons: `bg-[#E11D48] text-white hover:bg-rose-700`.
components.inputs: Minimal. For consumer: `border-b border-zinc-800 bg-transparent focus:border-white focus:ring-0`. No harsh white boxes.
components.cards: Cardless design where possible. If a card is needed (like the Escalation Card), use `bg-white/[0.02] border border-zinc-800 backdrop-blur-md p-8`.
components.badges: Always explicitly label AI. Use a small, tracking-widest uppercase badge `text-[10px] tracking-widest border border-zinc-700 px-2 py-1`.

rules: Fade and slight upward translate (`translate-y-2` to `0`) for new chat messages and onboarding steps.
Pulse animation strictly reserved for the 'streaming' state of AI or active Safety Escalation alerts.
Use abstract glass/shadow elements for marketing to maintain mystery and premium feel.
Use realistic, dramatic-lit portraits for human professionals.

image_urls.description: Dark curved abstract glass reflection. Use as massive hero background with bg-black/40 overlay.
Dark architectural shadow on concrete. Use as subtle background texture for the auth/stepper.
Young male professional portrait, dark lighting. Use in Human-handoff and Admin Professionals CRUD.
Elegant female professional, dark background. Use in Human-handoff.

universal_guidelines_for_main_agent: No generic AI slop. DO NOT use emojis for icons (e.g., no 🤖). Use pure lucide-react or phosphor icons.
Use 2x-3x more padding than usual. e.g., p-8 to p-12 on containers/wrappers.
Never apply `transition: all`. Target specific properties like `transition-opacity` or `transition-transform`.
Implement `data-testid` on ALL interactive elements (buttons, inputs, toggles, chat bubbles, admin rows).
Never use purely transparent backgrounds on drop-downs, sticky headers, or modals. Always use a solid dark color or `bg-black/60 backdrop-blur-xl`.
Prioritize pre-existing shadcn/ui components but heavily customize them via Tailwind to match this dark premium aesthetic (e.g., make them borderless or 0px radius depending on context).
Do not use generic grid cards for the chat UI. Text should breathe on the canvas.
Ensure 'Signal Red' (#E11D48) is strictly reserved for the Safety Net / Risk Escalation / Crisis Hotline flows to create immediate visual hierarchy.
